corrected_value.title: Intra-articular hyaluronic acid in treating knee osteoarthritis: a PRISMA-compliant systematic review of overlapping meta-analysis.

decisions.quote:
We replicated the Jadad assessments and evaluated whether we chose the same SR, whether a Cochrane SR was chosen, and whether we followed the same
steps as the Discordant Review authors.
decisions.reason: Lunny et al. (2022) empirically re-analyse the 10 included systematic reviews with meta-analyses of RCTs from Xing et al. (2016) [37] on hyaluronic acid versus placebo for early and late knee pain in knee osteoarthritis (Table 1), finding that independent Jadad reassessment selected Richette 2015 and Bellamy 2006 via Step H rather than the original authors' selection of Bellamy 2006 alone via Step I (Table 2, Table 3). The sole shipped row (input_row_index 2429, Bero & Jadad 1997, 10.7326/0003-4819-127-1-199707010-00007) is an uncited 1997 methodological guidance article (and was mapped to target_index 0, Bakdach & Hadad 2020 [13]), not an alternate report of Xing et al. (2016) [37], and Xing et al. (2016) does not duplicate any sibling target among the 21 reassessed Discordant Reviews. Prior source-access and outcome-scope objections are addressed via the lossless source view and by setting outcome to cannot_be_determined.
